title: Vivant "Ambit" - (Product Review)
description:
The guys over at Vivant sent me a few of their new Ambit units to try out! I've reviewed HUNDREDS of vaporizers between my channels over the years, and for an $80 vape... this thing actually surprised me quite a ton. I'd put this on the same level as most $200 vapes any day.
